pages.title: Chaos Emerald
pages.text: The Chaos Emerald jingle of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992) lasts about three seconds. Like the drowning jingle, it is credited to the sound assistant Yukifumi Makino, not to the composer Masato Nakamura.

pages.title: Seven emeralds
pages.text: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 has seven Chaos Emeralds, one more than the first game, and Dr. Robotnik wants them to power his space station, the Death Egg, says Wikipedia.
